headline: United States GP: Saturday qualifying at COTA after Leclerc paces Friday practice
whyCareReason: Qualifying begins Saturday at 16:00 local time. Antonelli holds 102-point lead over Russell.
teaser: Saturday qualifying at COTA. Leclerc led Friday; Antonelli +0.042s. Race Sunday 15:00 local.
story: The 2026 United States Grand Prix heads into decisive qualifying on Saturday, 24 October, at the Circuit of the Americas in Austin, Texas. Friday practice saw Ferrari's Charles Leclerc set the standard, topping both FP1 and FP2, with championship leader Kimi Antonelli finishing just 0.042 seconds behind in his Mercedes during the afternoon session. Max Verstappen and George Russell were also firmly in the mix inside the top four. Antonelli enters Saturday holding a 102-point lead over teammate Russell (340 to 238) and has his first opportunity to secure the drivers' crown this weekend. Qualifying is scheduled for 16:00 local time ahead of Sunday's 56-lap Grand Prix.
stakes: Pole position at COTA is on the line. Antonelli can take a massive step toward his first world championship.
rivalryAngle: Ferrari and Mercedes trade fastest sectors while Red Bull lurk in an intense qualifying fight.
funFacts: Charles Leclerc topped Friday practice in Austin, edging Antonelli by 0.042s in FP2.
Qualifying takes place Saturday at 16:00 local time at COTA.
